source.name: LK Design System Storybook information architecture audit
source.method: Built Storybook index census plus source-AST ownership/role analysis, followed by page-level human disposition review.

roleDefinitions.foundation-reference: Foundation token, principle, or source-model reference.
roleDefinitions.overview: The audience entry point: purpose, scope, and primary usage decision.
roleDefinitions.usage: Anatomy, composition, placement, or recommended usage.
roleDefinitions.variants-states: Variants, sizes, tones, states, loading, empty, or error treatment.
roleDefinitions.interaction: Keyboard, focus, pointer, controlled-state, or lifecycle behavior.
roleDefinitions.responsive: Narrow, mobile, compact, wide, density, or overflow behavior.
roleDefinitions.scenario: A representative Product or Robotics situation that explains the reusable contract.
roleDefinitions.visual-parity: Hidden visual-regression evidence for a real component surface.
roleDefinitions.internal-contract: Hidden implementation contract that is useful to tests but not sidebar navigation.

layerDescriptionContracts.Foundation: principle → semantic model → token/reference map → constraints → examples
layerDescriptionContracts.Core: definition → when to use/avoid → anatomy → variants/states → interaction/accessibility → related components
layerDescriptionContracts.Product: user problem → reusable workflow context → composition/ownership → states and recovery → responsive behavior → exclusions
layerDescriptionContracts.Robotics: operator goal → prerequisites/authority → safe reading and control order → state transitions → failure/recovery → narrow/field constraints
layerDescriptionContracts.Theme: brand role → allowed surfaces → variants → contrast/asset constraints → misuse to avoid

namingContract.pageTitles: Canonical English component names; explicit Primitives or Patterns labels for public family pages.
namingContract.publicLanguage: Korean audience language, with Latin text reserved for approved standards, keys, brands, and units.
namingContract.renamedPageIdPolicy: Renamed pages keep their previous explicit meta id so public story links remain stable.
